violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED YOGURT PARFAITS AT 53-55F AND HALF AND HALF AT 60F IN THE 4-DOOR STACKED COOLER. OBSERVED SALAD WITH GRILLED CHICKEN AT 47F AND A CHICKEN SANDWICH AT 46F IN THE 2-DOOR MARKET COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC CONFIRMED ANOTHER FOUR-DOOR COOLER BROKE IN THE MORNING SO FOODS WERE MOVED TO THE WORKING COOLER. AS A PRECAUTION, PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS. FOODS IN THE MARKET COOLER WERE DISCARDED OF AS WELL.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Internal condensate shelf of ice machine is not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC removed ice from machine and washed, rinsed, and sanitized all internal surfaces.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed burnt out light bulbs under the hood at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC contacted a technician to repair the socket in order to replace the burnt out light bulb.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Observed no test strips for bleach, which is the sanitizer currently used in the facility as the facility is out of quaternary ammonia supply.
violations.corrective_action: PIC obtained a bleach test kit.

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment. Observed that the facility is out of its quaternary ammonia supply, other sanitizers and is unable to properly sanitize food, non-food contact surfaces, food termometers.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. PIC purchased bleach during the inspection.
